design: 24 authored pairs from six templates; 16 required changes and 8 invariances, alternating candidate order. Labels fixed before inference. No tuning or threshold fitting. Six existing seed-11 released candidates, three sizes by continued SFT plus temperature or exact RL.
limits: Synthetic correlated templates, one checkpoint per method/size, no population inference, no PolicyLM benchmark. Candidate scores and correctness confidence reported separately.
